items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: Sidney Desvin is a coronet. Yeah.

ctx.x: This is an owl here. This is sitting there. Right where?

Right here. I can't see him at the night right now. Who can see him? Can you find Sidney out there? That's Rose right there. Oh, yes. Right by the... I think that's right there. I see him here. That's Rose. I know Rose.
He's standing second to the... Last. Oh, last on the end on the right. See the earphones they have? Oh, yes. It's not sure.

items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: And you know who's another good musician, too? Silence. Climate Fair, Piku.

ctx.x: I hadn't heard of it, so I just wondered. You don't know any more about him? If he's still living as a man, Steve, or anybody?
Jake is dead, but he must have some people living. He had a lot of children. And you know who's another good musician, too? Silence. Climate Fair, Piku. All the Pikus.
Yes. We were just talking about him.
